subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct option is: **Prefferance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **"Preference,"** which means a greater liking for one alternative over another or others. (प्राथमिकता)

 
 
• **​For example:** She has a preference for classical music over modern pop.
 
 

Hence,* "Preference"* is the word that is misspelled as "Preferance."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Preservation"** is spelled correctly and means the action of preserving something. (रक्षण)

 
 
• **​For example:** The preservation of historic buildings is important for cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **"Preponderance" **is also spelled correctly and refers to the quality or fact of being greater in number, quantity, or importance. (अधिकता)
 
 
• **​For example: **There was a preponderance of evidence against the defendant.
 
 
 
• **"Perseverance" **is the correct spelling for the quality that means steadfastness in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success. (सहनशीलता)
 
 
• **For Example:** Perseverance is the key to overcoming complex challenges and achieving success.
